purpose: Evidence-backed global discovery of Islamic resources by language; language presence is never treated as proof of translation quality or completeness.

evidence_sources.name: IslamHouse
evidence_sources.evidence: Official All Languages catalogue visibly reports Languages 133 and language-specific title counts.

evidence_sources.name: Encyclopedia of the Noble Quran
evidence_sources.evidence: Official catalogue states +80 Languages and +100 Translations and exposes translation metadata and API routes.

evidence_sources.name: Quran Foundation Content API
evidence_sources.evidence: Official API exposes ISO language codes and translations_count, translation resources, tafsirs and Content Sync.

evidence_sources.name: Encyclopedia of Translated Prophetic Hadiths
evidence_sources.evidence: Official site states 70 languages and exposes downloadable/API resources; language pages enumerate many additional languages and ISO-like codes.

discovery_method.phase_1: Enumerate first-party language catalogues and official APIs.
discovery_method.phase_2: Normalize language names to ISO codes only after evidence-backed mapping.
discovery_method.phase_3: Intersect language sets across Quran, hadith, tafsir, books and terminology resources.
discovery_method.phase_4: Attach provenance, rights and verification state to every resource, not merely to the language.
discovery_method.phase_5: Promote at least 106 evidence-backed language lanes; keep additional discovered lanes queued.
discovery_method.phase_6: Search regional, scholarly and institutional sources for languages underrepresented by the major global providers.

expansion_rule: Never stop at the first 106. Every newly evidenced language becomes a resource lane candidate and is promoted according to verification evidence.
no_auto_translation_rule: Automatic translation may only be stored as an explicitly labelled fallback and must never overwrite canonical Arabic or source-verified human translations.
